title: LEAP: Supercharging LLMs for Formal Mathematics with Agentic Frameworks
authors_zh: Po-Nien Kung、Linfeng Song、Dawsen Hwang、Jinsung Yoon、Chun-Liang Li、Simone Severini、Mirek Olšák、Edward Lockhart、Quoc V Le、Burak Gokturk、Thang Luong、Tomas Pfister、Nanyun Peng
paper_type_zh: Lean 形式化数学 benchmark 与 verifier 引导的测试时证明搜索
best_for_zh: 适合研究程序化 verifier、形式化数学评测、agentic proof search 与 test-time compute 归因的读者。
one_line: LEAP combines Gemini 3.1 Pro, compiler-guided revision, and an AND-OR proof DAG to produce Lean-checked outcomes, but releases successful proofs rather than replayable agent trajectories.
LEAP 用 Gemini 3.1 Pro、Lean 编译反馈和 AND-OR 证明 DAG 生成可机器验收的形式化结果，但公开物只有成功证明，没有可重放的 agent 轨迹。
why: For Programmatically Verifiable Outcome Data, it separates the exact terminal label supplied by Lean from the heuristic LLM judgment used to allocate search, and makes inference budget part of any fair comparison.
inclusion_reason: LEAP exposes a formal-mathematics evaluation surface where a long search process terminates in a mechanically checked Lean artifact, while also showing why a heuristic planning reviewer must be kept separate from the correctness verifier.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LEAP asks whether a general-purpose foundation model can solve long Lean theorem-proving tasks through structured interaction with the proof environment, rather than relying on one-shot generation or a specialized prover model. The authoritative paper is arXiv:2606.03303v2, submitted on 2 June 2026 and revised on 3 June 2026; no peer-reviewed venue was verified. The official project is https://imobench.github.io/, and the official release is under Google DeepMind's superhuman repository.

The paper also introduces Lean-IMO-Bench: 60 IMO-style problems from IMO-ProofBench, manually converted into Lean statements and divided into 30 Basic and 30 Advanced instances. A released benchmark row contains Problem ID, natural-language Problem, reference Solution, Grading guidelines, Category, Level, Short Answer, Source, and Lean Statement. For LEAP evaluation, that task record is paired with a generated Lean proof, the search budget, and a solved/unsolved checker outcome.

This belongs to Programmatically Verifiable Outcome Data because the decisive label is Lean acceptance of a complete proof artifact. It is not process supervision: an LLM reviewer filters proposed decompositions, but no step-level correctness labels or replayable trajectories are released. It is also not evidence for model training, because the paper performs inference-time search and evaluation rather than SFT, RLVR, or agent training. The Card reaches L4 on the strength of the full paper, appendix, benchmark CSV, result tables, license, and released successful proofs; exact framework code, model/toolchain versions, and failed traces remain unavailable. (Paper §§2-5, Appendix C; official repository at commit 96fa6c4.)

LEAP 研究的是：通用 foundation model 能否通过与证明环境进行结构化交互，完成长程 Lean theorem proving，而不是依赖 one-shot generation 或专用 prover model。权威论文为 arXiv:2606.03303v2，2026 年 6 月 2 日提交、6 月 3 日修订；尚未核验到 peer-reviewed venue。官方项目为 https://imobench.github.io/，官方发布位于 Google DeepMind 的 superhuman 仓库。

论文还引入 Lean-IMO-Bench：将 IMO-ProofBench 中 60 道 IMO 风格题目人工转换成 Lean statement，并分为 30 条 Basic 与 30 条 Advanced。每条公开 benchmark 记录包含 Problem ID、自然语言 Problem、参考 Solution、Grading guidelines、Category、Level、Short Answer、Source 和 Lean Statement。进入 LEAP 评测后，该任务记录还要与生成的 Lean proof、搜索预算以及 solved/unsolved checker outcome 配对。

它属于 Programmatically Verifiable Outcome Data，因为决定性标签是 Lean 对完整证明产物的验收。它不是 process supervision：LLM reviewer 虽会筛选候选分解，但论文没有发布步骤级正确性标签或可重放 trajectory。它也不是模型训练证据，因为论文执行的是 inference-time search 和 evaluation，而非 SFT、RLVR 或 agent training。Card 达到 L4 的证据包括论文全文与附录、benchmark CSV、结果表、许可证和成功证明发布；framework code、模型/工具链精确版本和失败 trace 仍不可得。（论文 §§2-5、Appendix C；官方仓库 commit 96fa6c4。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LEAP's contribution is an inference-time prover that lets Gemini 3.1 Pro alternate between informal mathematical planning and mechanically checked Lean artifacts while storing proof progress in a reusable AND-OR DAG. It first tries a direct informal-to-formal proof and compiler-feedback revisions. If that path fails, it proposes an informal blueprint, converts the plan into a Lean proof sketch, and turns the proposed lemmas into child goals only after the sketch type-checks and the state update remains acyclic. Shared lemma nodes provide memoization across branches; simple depth-first search and backtracking continue until the root is proved or the search stops. (Paper §§2.2-2.5, Figures 1-2.)

The feedback contract has two non-interchangeable parts. Lean observes syntax, types, dependencies, and whether a complete proof checks in the current environment. For a proof sketch, it verifies that the parent follows once the explicitly proposed child lemmas are assumed; sorry is confined to those child statements. Lean cannot determine whether the encoded theorem faithfully matches the intended informal problem or whether a decomposition is strategically useful. The LLM reviewer addresses the latter with a heuristic relevance/easiness/plausibility judgment, but it cannot certify mathematical correctness and no calibration is reported.

The closest empirical comparisons are one-shot Gemini 3.1 Pro, the specialized Goedel-Prover-V2-32B, Hilbert's recursive agentic search combining a general model with a specialized prover, and the proprietary Aristotle system. LEAP's key distinction is not a new proof checker or a new training corpus: it uses a general-purpose backend, checked blueprint decomposition, global DAG memory, and a planning reviewer at test time. Lean Blueprint, informal-to-formal planning, retrieval, compiler revision, and proof search all predate LEAP; the paper's direction signal is their integration with an exact terminal verifier and explicit compute accounting.

LEAP 的贡献是在 inference time 让 Gemini 3.1 Pro 在非形式化数学规划与机器检查的 Lean artifact 之间往返，并用可复用的 AND-OR DAG 保存证明进度。系统先尝试“非形式化论证到形式化证明”的直接路径，并依据 compiler feedback 修订；若失败，则提出 informal blueprint，将其转换成 Lean proof sketch。只有 sketch 通过类型检查且状态更新保持无环，候选 lemma 才会成为子目标。共享 lemma node 可跨分支 memoization；随后以简单 DFS 和 backtracking 继续搜索，直至根目标被证明或搜索终止。（论文 §§2.2-2.5、Figures 1-2。）

反馈契约包含两个不可互换的部分。Lean 能观察语法、类型、依赖，以及完整 proof 是否在当前环境中通过；对于 proof sketch，它核验“若显式提出的子 lemma 成立，则 parent goal 成立”，且 sorry 只能出现在这些子 lemma 的 statement 中。Lean 不能判断编码后的 theorem 是否忠实表达原始自然语言题目，也不能判断某次分解是否有搜索价值。LLM reviewer 用相关性、难度降低和可行性等 heuristic judgment 处理后一个问题，但它不能认证数学正确性，论文也未报告校准。

最接近的实证对照包括 one-shot Gemini 3.1 Pro、专用 Goedel-Prover-V2-32B、将通用模型与专用 prover 结合的递归 agentic search 系统 Hilbert，以及闭源 Aristotle。LEAP 的关键差别并非新 checker 或新训练语料，而是使用 general-purpose backend、经检查的 blueprint decomposition、全局 DAG memory 和 test-time planning reviewer。Lean Blueprint、informal-to-formal planning、retrieval、compiler revision 与 proof search 均非新组件；其方向信号在于把这些组件同精确 terminal verifier 与显式计算量记录结合起来。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and task state. The reported backend is Gemini 3.1 Pro. Each run starts from a Lean theorem statement, its definitions and dependencies, Mathlib context, LeanSearch retrieval, and an initially open root OR node. Lean-IMO-Bench contributes 60 records split 30/30 into Basic and Advanced; the experiments also use 12 Putnam 2025 statements and two combinatorics case studies. The paper does not disclose the exact Gemini snapshot, Lean version, Mathlib commit, LeanSearch index, prompts, temperature, or token limit.

Direct formalization. The model drafts an informal proof, translates it into Lean, executes the compiler, reads errors, retrieves relevant material with LeanSearch, and revises. In the component study, iterative formalization uses one initial attempt and up to 20 compiler-feedback revisions. A complete Lean-accepted proof resolves the current goal; failure triggers decomposition. (Figure 1; §5.1.)

Blueprint and search path. The model writes an informal blueprint with proposed supporting lemmas, then produces a formal proof sketch in which the parent proof is sorry-free and sorry may appear only in the newly proposed lemma statements. Lean checks this conditional parent derivation. An LLM reviewer separately assesses whether the decomposition is relevant, easier, and plausible. The state writer checks that the update keeps the dependency graph acyclic; accepted decompositions become AND nodes with child OR goals. The agent uses depth-first search, backtracking, and shared lemma nodes until all dependencies of a root-supporting AND node are proved. (Paper §§2.2-2.5; Appendix C.)

Outputs, selection, and use. The internal episode can contain informal plans, proof sketches, goals, DAG edges, candidate code, compiler messages, reviewer decisions, and budget counters. The released artifact contains completed Lean proof files, not that episode schema. Tables 2 and 4 mark LEAP as rollout=2; Table 3 reports 46 to about 3,000 LLM calls, 8 to 211 active nodes, and 300 to about 2,000 proof lines across solved Putnam problems. The terminal selection rule is a complete Lean-accepted proof. These outputs support evaluation, test-time-compute comparison, and audit, not a paper-demonstrated training objective.

Reproduction boundary. Pin arXiv v2, repository commit 96fa6c4cc3a9bb7450ee7b6773b659d3a030dace, the benchmark CSV, every theorem file, Lean/Mathlib/LeanSearch revisions, model/API snapshot, prompts, sampling settings, rollout/revision limits, and per-problem call and wall-clock budgets. The release does not supply the LEAP implementation, an environment manifest, or failed trajectories, so the public artifacts permit proof inspection but not end-to-end replay.

输入与任务状态。 报告使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 作为 backend。每次运行从 Lean theorem statement、其定义和依赖、Mathlib context、LeanSearch retrieval，以及一个未解决的 root OR node 开始。Lean-IMO-Bench 提供 60 条记录，Basic 与 Advanced 各 30 条；实验还使用 12 道 Putnam 2025 题目和两个组合数学 case study。论文未披露精确 Gemini snapshot、Lean version、Mathlib commit、LeanSearch index、prompt、temperature 或 token limit。

Direct formalization。 模型先写 informal proof，再翻译成 Lean，执行 compiler，读取错误，使用 LeanSearch 检索相关材料并修订。在组件实验中，iterative formalization 从一次初始尝试开始，最多进行 20 次 compiler-feedback revision。完整 proof 若被 Lean 接受，则当前目标完成；否则进入分解路径。（Figure 1；§5.1。）

Blueprint 与搜索路径。 模型生成包含 supporting lemma 的 informal blueprint，再生成 formal proof sketch；其中 parent proof 必须是 sorry-free，sorry 仅可出现在新提出的 lemma statement 中。Lean 检查这一条件化的 parent derivation。LLM reviewer 再单独判断分解是否相关、更容易且可行。state writer 检查更新后 dependency graph 仍为无环；通过的 decomposition 形成 AND node，其子目标形成 OR node。agent 使用 DFS、backtracking 和共享 lemma node，直到支持 root 的某个 AND node 的全部依赖都被证明。（论文 §§2.2-2.5；Appendix C。）

输出、筛选与用途。 内部 episode 可包含 informal plan、proof sketch、goal、DAG edge、候选代码、compiler message、reviewer decision 和预算计数器；公开 artifact 只有完成的 Lean proof file，没有上述 episode schema。Tables 2 与 4 将 LEAP 标为 rollout=2；Table 3 报告各 Putnam 成功证明使用 46 至约 3,000 次 LLM call、8 至 211 个 active node，以及 300 至约 2,000 行证明。terminal selection rule 是完整 proof 被 Lean 接受。这些输出支持 evaluation、test-time-compute comparison 与 audit，不支持论文已经证明的训练目标。

复现边界。 复现时应固定 arXiv v2、仓库 commit 96fa6c4cc3a9bb7450ee7b6773b659d3a030dace、benchmark CSV、每个 theorem file、Lean/Mathlib/LeanSearch revision、model/API snapshot、prompt、sampling setting、rollout/revision limit，以及逐题 call 与 wall-clock budget。公开物没有 LEAP 实现、环境 manifest 或失败 trajectory，因此可以检查 proof，但不能 end-to-end replay。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper's results are conditioned on Gemini 3.1 Pro as the LEAP backend and on unequal forms of test-time search. They have not been independently reproduced in this Card.

  • On Putnam 2025, Table 2 reports 12/12 solved by LEAP with two rollouts. Gemini 3.1 Pro and Goedel-Prover-V2-32B each solve 0/12 under pass@128; Hilbert solves 4/12 with two rollouts, and Aristotle solves 9/12 with two rollouts. Table 3 shows that LEAP's successful proofs are not equal-budget events: 46 to about 3,000 LLM calls, 8 to 211 active DAG nodes, and 300 to about 2,000 proof lines per problem.
  • On Lean-IMO-Bench, Table 4 reports 25/30 Basic (83.3%) and 17/30 Advanced (56.7%) for LEAP, giving 42/60 or 70% overall. Aristotle records 23/30 and 6/30; Hilbert records 11/30 and 2/30. LEAP still solves only 1/6 Basic geometry and 1/8 Advanced geometry problems.
  • The iterative-revision ablation in Table 5 raises Gemini 3.1 Pro on the Basic set from 20.0% one-shot pass@128 to 36.6% with one initial sample plus up to 20 revisions, while Goedel-Prover-V2-32B decreases from 10.0% to 6.6%. This negative result limits the claim: compiler feedback is not uniformly useful across backends.
  • Removing global DAG memory reduces Basic/Advanced solve rates from 83.3/56.7 to 73.3/40.0 (Table 6). Removing the LLM decomposition reviewer makes Putnam A5 fail after eight rollouts, whereas the full setup solves it with two; Figure 3 shows a formally admissible decomposition that merely recreates its ancestor goal.

The official repository corroborates artifact availability by publishing the successful Lean proofs for 12 Putnam tasks, 42 solved Lean-IMO-Bench tasks, and two open-problem cases. It does not corroborate replayability: agent code, prompts, DAG logs, compiler-message histories, and unsuccessful branches are absent. Benchmark performance therefore supports the paper's evaluation claim, not a claim that the released data or verifier pipeline is complete or training-ready.

论文结果以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 为 LEAP backend，并使用不同形式、不同预算的 test-time search。本 Card 未独立复现实验。

  • Putnam 2025 的 Table 2 报告 LEAP 在两个 rollout 下解出 12/12；Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Goedel-Prover-V2-32B 在 pass@128 下均为 0/12，Hilbert 在两个 rollout 下为 4/12，Aristotle 在两个 rollout 下为 9/12。Table 3 显示成功证明并非等预算事件：每题使用 46 至约 3,000 次 LLM call、8 至 211 个 active DAG node、300 至约 2,000 行 proof。
  • Lean-IMO-Bench 的 Table 4 报告 LEAP 解出 Basic 25/30（83.3%）和 Advanced 17/30（56.7%），合计 42/60，即 70%。Aristotle 分别为 23/30 与 6/30，Hilbert 为 11/30 与 2/30。LEAP 在 Geometry 上仍只有 Basic 1/6、Advanced 1/8。
  • Table 5 的 iterative-revision ablation 显示，Basic set 上 Gemini 3.1 Pro 从 one-shot pass@128 的 20.0% 提升到“一次初始 sample + 最多 20 次 revision”的 36.6%；Goedel-Prover-V2-32B 则从 10.0% 降到 6.6%。这个 negative result 限定了结论：compiler feedback 并非对所有 backend 都有效。
  • 去掉全局 DAG memory 后，Basic/Advanced solve rate 从 83.3/56.7 降到 73.3/40.0（Table 6）。去掉 LLM decomposition reviewer 后，Putnam A5 在八个 rollout 后仍失败，而完整配置以两个 rollout 解出；Figure 3 展示了一次形式上可接受、实质上只是重建祖先目标的分解。

官方仓库发布了 12 道 Putnam、42 道已解 Lean-IMO-Bench 以及两个 open-problem case 的成功 Lean proof，因此可以核验 artifact availability。但它不能证明 replayability：agent code、prompt、DAG log、compiler-message history 与失败分支均未发布。benchmark performance 支持论文的 evaluation claim，不等于公开数据或 verifier pipeline 已完整、可训练。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior Lean systems offer several pieces used here: Lean provides kernel-backed checking; LeanSearch retrieves Mathlib material; Lean Blueprint represents human proof plans as dependency graphs; Draft, Sketch, and Prove connects informal arguments to formal proving; specialized systems such as Goedel-Prover-V2 and AlphaProof train formal provers; Hilbert and Aristotle add agentic search. LEAP does not make these components new, and its benchmark expansion is separate from the proof-search mechanism.

What changes is the allocation of responsibilities. A general-purpose model supplies informal reasoning, proof generation, decomposition, revision, and a heuristic decomposition review. Lean supplies the executable acceptance predicate. An AND-OR DAG supplies global proof memory, shared lemmas, anticipatory lemma planning, and acyclic dependency tracking, rather than treating every decomposition as an independent recursive subtree. The Lean-IMO-Bench release supplies a 60-instance evaluation surface whose statements were manually formalized from IMO-ProofBench. The DAG and reviewer ablations make these choices distinguishable from adding more samples alone.

For reasoning-data research, this is useful because it separates three records that are often collapsed: a checker-accepted artifact, a judge-approved search decision, and the compute used to reach it. The release only preserves the first consistently. Before reuse, verify statement fidelity, pin the proof environment and backend, normalize compute across methods, inspect benchmark exposure, and obtain the missing failed branches and reviewer outputs. Without those checks, the work is a strong evaluation/reference design but not a complete trajectory-data recipe.

已有 Lean 系统已经提供 LEAP 使用的多种组件：Lean 提供 kernel-backed checking，LeanSearch 检索 Mathlib 材料，Lean Blueprint 用 dependency graph 表示人类证明计划，Draft, Sketch, and Prove 连接非形式化论证与形式化证明，Goedel-Prover-V2、AlphaProof 等系统训练专用 formal prover，Hilbert 与 Aristotle 使用 agentic search。LEAP 没有使这些组件本身变新，benchmark 扩展也应与 proof-search mechanism 分开评价。

真正改变的是职责分配。general-purpose model 负责 informal reasoning、proof generation、decomposition、revision 和 heuristic decomposition review；Lean 提供可执行 acceptance predicate；AND-OR DAG 提供全局 proof memory、共享 lemma、anticipatory lemma planning 和无环 dependency tracking，而不是把每次分解当作彼此独立的递归 subtree。Lean-IMO-Bench 发布 60 条由 IMO-ProofBench 人工形式化得到的评测记录。DAG 与 reviewer ablation 使这些设计选择可以同“只增加 sample 数量”区分开。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，其价值在于区分常被混为一谈的三种记录：checker-accepted artifact、judge-approved search decision 与到达结果所用 compute。公开发布只稳定保留了第一种。复用前仍要检查 statement fidelity、固定 proof environment 和 backend、跨方法规范化 compute、核验 benchmark exposure，并补齐失败分支与 reviewer output。没有这些条件时，它是有用的 evaluation/reference design，而非完整 trajectory-data recipe。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Method and feedback. Lean checking is exact relative to an encoded statement and active dependency environment, but it cannot establish that a manual formalization preserves the intended natural-language problem. A checked sketch can also introduce mathematically valid but strategically useless subgoals. LEAP delegates that distinction to an LLM reviewer; the Putnam A5 ablation demonstrates one benefit, but the paper does not report reviewer calibration, false-positive/false-negative rates, alternative reviewers, or robustness to prompt changes. Search remains costly and irregular: successful Putnam proofs require 46 to about 3,000 LLM calls, and future work explicitly identifies branch prioritization and compute allocation as open problems.

Data and release. The official repository provides the benchmark CSV and successful proof files, but not the LEAP implementation, prompts, model configuration, DAG state schema, compiler-feedback history, reviewer outputs, or failed/rejected candidates. This successful-only release blocks analyses of branch waste, verifier-triggered repair, reviewer bias, and failure retention. It also has no Lean toolchain, Mathlib lock, or LeanSearch-index manifest. Although the repository states Apache-2.0 for software and CC-BY for other materials, downstream users should retain each problem's source metadata and separately review original competition-material rights.

Evaluation and generalization. The results depend on Gemini 3.1 Pro, two-rollout LEAP runs, and method-specific budgets; a solve-rate comparison is not a compute-matched comparison. Geometry remains weak at 1/6 Basic and 1/8 Advanced. Pretraining overlap and decontamination are not reported, and two comparison systems are proprietary or incompletely reproducible. The case study formalizes a Color-2 planar routing subproblem of the Hamiltonian decomposition construction, not the complete open problem. Curator inference: model-service drift, Mathlib changes, or an updated retrieval index could change both acceptance and search behavior even when the paper's headline algorithm is unchanged.

方法与反馈。 Lean checking 只对编码后的 statement 和当前 dependency environment 精确，不能证明人工 formalization 忠实表达原始自然语言题目。通过检查的 sketch 也可能引入数学上有效、搜索上无用的 subgoal。LEAP 将这一区分交给 LLM reviewer；Putnam A5 ablation 展示了一项收益，但论文没有报告 reviewer calibration、false-positive/false-negative rate、替代 reviewer 或 prompt-change robustness。搜索成本高且不稳定：Putnam 成功证明使用 46 至约 3,000 次 LLM call，论文的 future work 也把 branch prioritization 与 compute allocation 列为开放问题。

数据与发布。 官方仓库提供 benchmark CSV 和成功 proof file，但没有 LEAP 实现、prompt、model configuration、DAG state schema、compiler-feedback history、reviewer output 或失败/被拒候选。成功样本-only 发布使 branch waste、verifier-triggered repair、reviewer bias 和 failure retention 无法审计。公开物也没有 Lean toolchain、Mathlib lock 或 LeanSearch-index manifest。仓库虽声明软件为 Apache-2.0、其他材料为 CC-BY，下游仍应保留逐题 source metadata，并单独审查原始竞赛材料的权利。

实验与泛化。 结果依赖 Gemini 3.1 Pro、LEAP 的两个 rollout 和各方法不同的预算；solve-rate comparison 不是 compute-matched comparison。Geometry 仍只有 Basic 1/6、Advanced 1/8。论文未报告 pretraining overlap 或 decontamination，两个对照系统为 proprietary 或难以完整复现。case study 形式化的是 Hamiltonian decomposition 构造中 Color-2 planar routing subproblem，而非完整 open problem。Curator inference：即使算法描述不变，model-service drift、Mathlib 更新或 retrieval index 变化也可能改变验收与搜索行为。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Programmatically Verifiable Outcome Data track, LEAP is a concrete design for keeping a terminal verifier separate from a search judge. A reusable run record should store the benchmark row and source, formal statement, environment revision, backend/model configuration, informal plan, DAG node and dependencies, candidate Lean artifact, exact compiler feedback, reviewer decision, rollout/revision/call budget, final proof, and Lean verdict. LEAP's public release supplies the benchmark rows and successful final artifacts, but not the intervening fields.

Practical uses are therefore bounded:

  • evaluate formal provers on the 30 Basic and 30 Advanced Lean-IMO-Bench statements while reporting pass@k or rollout budget;
  • reproduce the released proof artifacts under a pinned Lean/Mathlib environment and audit statement fidelity;
  • compare direct generation, iterative compiler revision, tree search, DAG memoization, and decomposition review under equalized call or token budgets;
  • design failure logging that preserves Lean rejections and reviewer-pruned branches rather than keeping successes only;
  • use Tables 3-6 as an audit checklist for separating model quality, search structure, heuristic review, and test-time compute.

Reuse class: safe as an evaluation and audit reference after snapshot pinning. End-to-end reproduction is blocked pending the framework, prompts, model/toolchain versions, and failed trajectories. The paper does not establish safe training reuse, agent training, SFT, or RLVR from the released artifacts.

对 Programmatically Verifiable Outcome Data track，LEAP 是一个将 terminal verifier 与 search judge 分开的具体设计。可复用 run record 应保存 benchmark row 与 source、formal statement、environment revision、backend/model configuration、informal plan、DAG node 与 dependency、候选 Lean artifact、精确 compiler feedback、reviewer decision、rollout/revision/call budget、final proof 和 Lean verdict。LEAP 的公开物提供 benchmark row 与成功 final artifact，但没有中间字段。

因此，实际用途必须保持边界：

  • 在 30 条 Basic 与 30 条 Advanced Lean-IMO-Bench statement 上评测 formal prover，并同时报告 pass@k 或 rollout budget；
  • 在固定 Lean/Mathlib 环境中重放公开 proof artifact，并审计 statement fidelity；
  • 在 call 或 token 预算对齐时，对照 direct generation、iterative compiler revision、tree search、DAG memoization 与 decomposition review；
  • 设计 failure logging，保留 Lean rejection 与 reviewer-pruned branch，而非只保留成功结果；
  • 用 Tables 3-6 作为 audit checklist，区分 model quality、search structure、heuristic review 与 test-time compute。

复用等级：固定 snapshot 后，可安全作为 evaluation 与 audit reference。end-to-end reproduction 仍受 framework、prompt、model/toolchain version 与失败 trajectory 缺失阻断。论文没有建立从公开 artifact 进行 training reuse、agent training、SFT 或 RLVR 的安全性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Figure 1 with §§2.2-2.5: Lean accepts formal artifacts, while the LLM reviewer only filters whether a decomposition appears useful.
  • Read Tables 2-4 with Table 3; the 70% Lean-IMO-Bench result and 12/12 Putnam result use search whose cost ranges from 46 to about 3,000 LLM calls per solved Putnam problem.
  • Table 5 is the key negative result: compiler-feedback revision helps Gemini 3.1 Pro but not Goedel-Prover-V2-32B under the reported setup.
  • Tables 6 and the Putnam A5 reviewer ablation separate DAG memory and decomposition review from generic best-of-N sampling.
  • Inspect the pinned CSV and proof repository before reuse; the benchmark and successful proofs are public, but implementation, environment locks, prompts, failed branches, and decontamination evidence are not.

• 将 Figure 1 与 §§2.2-2.5 对照阅读：Lean 验收 formal artifact，LLM reviewer 只筛选 decomposition 是否看起来有用。
  • 将 Tables 2-4 与 Table 3 一起读；70% 的 Lean-IMO-Bench 结果和 Putnam 12/12 使用了搜索，而各成功 Putnam 题的成本为 46 至约 3,000 次 LLM call。
  • Table 5 是关键 negative result：在报告设置下，compiler-feedback revision 帮助 Gemini 3.1 Pro，却没有帮助 Goedel-Prover-V2-32B。
  • Table 6 与 Putnam A5 reviewer ablation 把 DAG memory、decomposition review 同普通 best-of-N sampling 区分开。
  • 复用前检查 pinned CSV 与 proof repository；benchmark 和成功证明已公开，但实现、环境锁、prompt、失败分支与 decontamination evidence 均未公开。

value.html: Lean-IMO-Bench contains 60 records derived from IMO-ProofBench, split into 30 Basic and 30 Advanced problems; the official CSV fields are Problem ID, Problem, Solution, Grading guidelines, Category, Level, Short Answer, Source, and Lean Statement. The evaluation also uses the 12 Putnam 2025 problems and two combinatorics case studies.

value_zh.html: Lean-IMO-Bench 含 60 条源自 IMO-ProofBench 的记录，划分为 30 道 Basic 与 30 道 Advanced 问题；官方 CSV 字段为 Problem ID、Problem、Solution、Grading guidelines、Category、Level、Short Answer、Source 与 Lean Statement。评测还使用 12 道 Putnam 2025 问题与两项组合学案例研究。

value.html: A completed Lean 4 proof artifact paired with a Lean compiler/kernel acceptance outcome. Aggregate evaluation records additionally require problem identity, method, rollout or sampling budget, and solved/unsolved status.

value_zh.html: 已完成的 Lean 4 证明产物，配对 Lean 编译器/内核接受结果。聚合评测记录另外需要问题身份、方法、rollout 或采样预算，以及已解决/未解决状态。

value.html: Gemini 3.1 Pro is the reported LEAP backend. Internally it produces informal proofs, informal blueprints, Lean proof sketches, AND-OR DAG updates, candidate proofs, and revisions; the public release contains successful Lean proofs, not complete trajectories.

value_zh.html: Gemini 3.1 Pro 是所报告的 LEAP 后端。其内部产生非形式证明、非形式蓝图、Lean 证明草图、AND-OR DAG 更新、候选证明与修订；公开发布含成功的 Lean 证明，而非完整轨迹。

value.html: Lean 4 with Mathlib, LeanSearch retrieval, an AND-OR DAG state store, simple depth-first search, backtracking, and Gemini 3.1 Pro model calls. Exact Lean, Mathlib, LeanSearch-index, and model snapshot versions are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: Lean 4 配合 Mathlib、LeanSearch 检索、AND-OR DAG 状态存储、简单深度优先搜索、回溯与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 模型调用。确切的 Lean、Mathlib、LeanSearch-index 与模型快照版本未披露。

value.html: Lean compilation/type checking is the programmatic correctness verifier. A separate LLM reviewer judges whether a proposed decomposition is relevant, easier, and plausible; this heuristic controls search but does not certify the final proof.

value_zh.html: Lean 编译/类型检查是程序化正确性验证器。单独的 LLM 审阅者判定所提议分解是否相关、更易且合理；该启发式控制搜索但不认证最终证明。

value.html: A complete, sorry-free proof of the target theorem is accepted by Lean in the evaluation environment. A proof sketch can enter the DAG only when Lean accepts the parent derivation with sorry placeholders confined to explicitly proposed child lemmas.

value_zh.html: 目标定理的完整、无 sorry 证明被评测环境中的 Lean 接受。仅当 Lean 接受父推导且 sorry 占位符限于明确提议的子引理时，证明草图才能进入 DAG。

value.html: Gemini 3.1 Pro in the reported LEAP experiments.

value_zh.html: 所报告 LEAP 实验中的 Gemini 3.1 Pro。

value.html: No training teacher is used. Lean compiler feedback supplies executable correction signals, while an LLM reviewer supplies a non-binding decomposition-quality judgment.

value_zh.html: 未使用训练教师。Lean 编译器反馈提供可执行校正信号，而 LLM 审阅者提供非约束的分解质量判定。

value.html: The backend model generates informal arguments, blueprints, supporting lemmas, proof sketches, full Lean proofs, and revisions.

value_zh.html: 后端模型生成非形式论证、蓝图、支撑引理、证明草图、完整 Lean 证明与修订。

value.html: Lean-IMO-Bench, Putnam 2025, and the formal statements for the two reported combinatorics case studies.

value_zh.html: Lean-IMO-Bench、Putnam 2025，以及两项所报告组合学案例研究的形式陈述。

value.html: LEAP is reported with two rollouts in Tables 2 and 4. The direct iterative component starts from one attempt and allows up to 20 compiler-feedback revisions in Table 5. Exact prompts and sampling parameters are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: LEAP 在表 2 与表 4 中报告两次 rollout。直接迭代组件从一次尝试开始，并允许最多 20 次编译器反馈修订（表 5）。确切提示与采样参数未披露。

value.html: Two for the reported LEAP benchmark tables; the no-reviewer Putnam A5 ablation runs eight unsuccessful rollouts.

value_zh.html: 所报告 LEAP 基准表为两次；无审阅者的 Putnam A5 消融运行八次不成功的 rollout。

value.html: Lean acceptance is binary for formal artifacts. The LLM reviewer threshold, prompt, calibration, and tie policy are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 对形式产物，Lean 接受为二元。LLM 审阅者阈值、提示、校准与平局策略未披露。

value.html: Lean rejects ill-typed proofs and sketches; the LLM reviewer can reject unhelpful decompositions; the state writer rejects cyclic DAG updates; search backtracks from failed branches. Only a complete Lean-accepted proof counts as solved.

value_zh.html: Lean 拒绝类型不正确的证明与草图；LLM 审阅者可拒绝无帮助的分解；状态写入器拒绝循环 DAG 更新；搜索从失败分支回溯。仅完整的 Lean 接受证明计为已解决。

value.html: Table 3 reports 46 to approximately 3,000 LLM calls per solved Putnam problem, 8 to 211 active DAG nodes, and 300 to approximately 2,000 final proof lines. A uniform wall-clock, token, or monetary budget is not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 表 3 报告每个已解决 Putnam 问题 46 至约 3,000 次 LLM 调用、8 至 211 个活跃 DAG 节点，以及 300 至约 2,000 行最终证明。未披露统一的墙钟、token 或金钱预算。

value.html: Direct formalization with LeanSearch-assisted revision, followed when needed by informal blueprint generation, checked proof sketches, AND-OR DAG memoization, LLM review, depth-first search, and backtracking. No model optimization is performed.

value_zh.html: 用 LeanSearch 辅助修订进行直接形式化，必要时继以非形式蓝图生成、经检查的证明草图、AND-OR DAG 记忆化、LLM 审阅、深度优先搜索与回溯。不执行模型优化。

value.html: arXiv:2606.03303v2, the official IMO-Bench project, the official superhuman repository, the 60-row Lean-IMO-Bench CSV, and the released successful Lean proof files.

value_zh.html: arXiv:2606.03303v2、官方 IMO-Bench 项目、官方 superhuman 仓库、60 行 Lean-IMO-Bench CSV，以及已发布的成功 Lean 证明文件。

value.html: Lean-IMO-Bench has 30 Basic and 30 Advanced evaluation instances. Putnam 2025 has 12 separate evaluation problems. The paper describes evaluation, not a train/validation/test training split.

value_zh.html: Lean-IMO-Bench 有 30 个 Basic 与 30 个 Advanced 评测实例。Putnam 2025 有 12 道独立评测问题。论文描述评测，而非 train/validation/test 训练划分。

value.html: Lean-IMO-Bench is derived from IMO-ProofBench; Putnam 2025 and public benchmark exposure are explicit. Pretraining overlap or decontamination for Gemini 3.1 Pro and the baselines is not reported.

value_zh.html: Lean-IMO-Bench 源自 IMO-ProofBench；Putnam 2025 与公开基准暴露是明确的。未报告 Gemini 3.1 Pro 与基线的预训练重叠或去污染。

value.html: The release contains successful Lean proofs for all 12 Putnam problems, 42 solved Lean-IMO-Bench instances, and two open-problem artifacts. Failed proofs, rejected decompositions, compiler-message histories, and complete DAG/rollout traces are not released.

value_zh.html: 该发布含全部 12 道 Putnam 问题的成功 Lean 证明、42 个已解决 Lean-IMO-Bench 实例，以及两件开放问题产物。失败证明、被拒绝的分解、编译器消息历史与完整 DAG/rollout 轨迹未发布。

items: Lean acceptance establishes the encoded theorem under the active environment, not fidelity to the intended informal statement.
The LLM reviewer can prefer plausible but unproductive decompositions or prune a useful branch; only one reviewer ablation is reported.
Search cost varies by more than an order of magnitude across Putnam problems and is not normalized to a fixed token or wall-clock budget.
Geometry solve rates remain 1/6 on Basic and 1/8 on Advanced for LEAP.
Results can drift with Gemini, Lean, Mathlib, LeanSearch, prompt, or service changes because exact versions are not pinned.
Successful-only proof release prevents auditing failed attempts, reviewer false positives/negatives, and branching efficiency.
Benchmark/pretraining contamination is not measured.
Lean 接受确立活跃环境下的已编码定理，而非对预期非形式陈述的忠实性。
LLM 审阅者可能偏好看似合理但无成效的分解或剪枝有用分支；仅报告一次审阅者消融。
搜索成本在 Putnam 问题间相差超过一个数量级，且未归一化到固定 token 或墙钟预算。
LEAP 的几何求解率在 Basic 上仍为 1/6，在 Advanced 上仍为 1/8。
由于确切版本未固定，结果可随 Gemini、Lean、Mathlib、LeanSearch、提示或服务变化而漂移。
仅发布成功证明妨碍审计失败尝试、审阅者假阳性/假阴性与分支效率。
未测量基准/预训练污染。
